action: Applied deterministic overrides (GDPR Article 22C; AML/KYC Reg. 33 & 35)

details.decision_rationale: The low overall risk rating is supported by a full identity match, clean device reputation, high residency score confirmed, document authentication passing with a score of 96/100, and a facial match score of 93/100. The liveness check also passed, and no PEP or sanctions match was found. The compliance findings indicate FCA compliance due to the detailed analysis satisfying FCA principles, and AML/KYC compliance due to no PEP match and no Enhanced Due Diligence required. However, GDPR compliance is an issue, as no human is reviewing this case, and the Confidence Score of 95 compared against the threshold of 70 means Article 22C safeguards are required but not currently in place. Enhanced Due Diligence is not required, as the risk score did not exceed 75 and no PEP match was found. The combination of these risk and compliance findings supports the final recommendation of no further action required.
final_recommendations: Implement Article 22C safeguards to ensure GDPR compliance
No further action required for AML/KYC and FCA compliance

details.reason: The decision rationale provides a clear and well-reasoned explanation for the decision, citing a full identity match, clean device reputation, and high residency score confirmed, which satisfies the Consumer Duty principle of acting in good faith (PRIN 2A.2.2R). The audit trail summary shows a complete record of the risk analysis, compliance check, and report generation, demonstrating senior management accountability as required by the SM&CR.
